analysis.estimand: paired descriptive difference in maximum horizon-aggregate directed-ISL utilization between 2 MHz and 5 MHz under one fixed trace, seed, routing, topology, access, demand, emission and observation contract; the preregistered branch decision additionally requires receipt-bound one-second directed-link and episode-coincident same-link matched queue-wait diagnostics in both arms

planned_contrasts.name: b2_minus_b5
planned_contrasts.estimand: paired engineering bandwidth sensitivity plus the separately frozen pressure classification in CODE/work/WP-LEO-V2-ISL-BANDWIDTH-PILOT/R03/pressure-decision.json; not a statistical algorithm or paper-facing effect claim

can_claim: the two declared cells use the same actual trace, seed, deterministic hop routing, topology, access, demand, emission, observation and drain contracts
the only declared intervention is links.rf_isl.bandwidth_hz, while SNR, MCS, data service time and control service time are physical consequences of that intervention
verified raw service and available-capacity intervals can be rebinned into fixed one-second directed-ISL windows with served bits and available capacity reported separately

a PRESSURE_CANDIDATE requires the 5 MHz control to have no qualifying pressure episode and the 2 MHz arm to have one directed ISL with at least two consecutive one-second windows at utilization at least 0.8, at least 0.9 available seconds in each counted window, and same-link queue waiting overlapping that episode with max wait at least 0.1 seconds and episode queue area at least 100000 bit-seconds
if the 5 MHz control already has a qualifying pressure episode, classify CONTROL_PRESSURE_UNBRACKETED and do not claim a 5-to-2 MHz onset interval
the ordered classification and subsequent action are frozen in CODE/work/WP-LEO-V2-ISL-BANDWIDTH-PILOT/R03/pressure-decision.json before execution
cannot_claim: algorithm superiority, a causal information-value effect or a new-algorithm contribution
a universal or paper-ready ISL congestion threshold from one seed and one scenario
a pure capacity multiplier effect, because bandwidth also changes noise, SNR, MCS and control-packet service time

congestion when zero-rate holds occur, candidate access grants differ from control, candidate access, geometry, outage or NO_ROUTE fates exceed control, holding-queue overflow occurs, candidate control expired/lost/geometry-lost/overflow exceeds control, natural end or conservation fails, or current external witness evidence is absent; ISL queue overflow is a congestion outcome but cannot replace the preregistered localized pressure episode
a fully usable pressure scenario when the candidate has any in-system packet at stop or unmatched ISL queue entry; that branch is DRAIN_INCOMPLETE and requires longer-drain confirmation
a 1 MHz result or dose-response curve when R04 was not executed
execution authorization before exact-revision independent review, accepted finalization, clean-main deployment and external witness gates close
